audience: managers and HR teams who plan shifts, absences and working time in Papershift

useCases.title: See who is absent and how many vacation days are left
useCases.text: The AI lists absences between two dates, with type, hours and vacation days, and reads an employee's vacation entitlements: planned, spent and carry-over days.

useCases.title: Review tracked hours and overtime
useCases.text: The AI lists worked-time entries and an employee's daily evaluations (target, planned and actual hours), plus the contractual target hours.

useCases.title: Check planned shifts and who is assigned
useCases.text: The AI lists shifts of a location between two dates, by working area or tag, and shows who is assigned to a shift and who applied.

useCases.title: Record an absence or decide on a request
useCases.text: The AI records an absence such as vacation or sick leave for an employee, or confirms, rejects or resets an absence request.

useCases.title: Add or confirm worked time
useCases.text: The AI adds a worked-time entry after the fact, with start, end and break minutes, or confirms an entry so it counts as final.

useCases.title: Plan a shift and assign employees
useCases.text: The AI creates a shift in a location and working area for a number of employees, and puts an employee on it.
